scope: Arabic Gregorian date and current Jeddah temperature replies integrated with the two-stage wake assistant
display: Live tmux terminal mirrored to user's browser; connected UI and commands verified

weather_check.meaning: City weather model current conditions, not an indoor sensor or daily maximum
weather_check.status: passed: live HTTPS on Pi, validated units and freshness

automated_tests.coverage: Saudi midnight date boundary, exact/negated/mixed routing, no ROS for information, confidence rejection, negative/decimal speech, invalid/stale/future/wrong-unit weather and network timeout

live_voice_trials.outcome: Rejected non-matching transcription; no approximate alias added. Expanded vocabulary context to full date/weather questions before retry.

live_voice_trials.vocabulary_context: اللمبة، كم التاريخ اليوم، كم درجة الحرارة اليوم

limitations: One successful live date trial and one successful weather retry are limited evidence, not a general recognition benchmark
Reported RSS is the parent process high-water mark, not a combined peak including the short-lived TTS worker; live scopes limited total memory to 1400 MB
Threshold zero is an explicit supervised demo setting, not calibrated recognition accuracy
No general Arabic/wake benchmark or boot-start service
